packageRules.description: ci/requirements.txt is a lock generated from ci/requirements.in by the pip-compile manager; plain pip_requirements must not bump its transitive pins one by one.

The -trixie images stand in for a Debian 13 laptop (debian13-quickstart, debian13-vm-run, quickstart-check-preview), so they stay on Debian 13's system Python, 3.13: trixie's python3-apt is built for CPython 3.13 only (catalog#184). Digest updates of the 3.13 tags still flow; the guard is tests/test_public_contract.py::test_debian13_laptop_jobs_use_debian13_python.
